{{Quote|What Rivoche hears isn't the kind of information most Rebel agents can get. We wouldn't have evacuated New Cylimba if it weren't for her.|[[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], on [[Rivoche Tarkin]]|<ref name="CRO" />}}
The '''evacuation''' of [[New Cylimba]] was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] operation during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Alliance was able to conduct the evacuation due to information gathered by the deep-cover [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Rivoche Tarkin]].<ref name="SF" />
